_readme: This file is data, not code. The app reads it to populate the Community Templates section and
installs nothing until the user presses Use on an entry. It is not a provider list and it is
Every entry points a provider id, already known to the engine's own catalogue, at a base URL.
An entry never contains a credential and is not an endorsement, a partnership, or a permission.
Whoever connects an account is responsible for that service's terms, quotas, and usage rules.

presets.label: OpenCode Zen
presets.description: Community template. Points the opencode provider id at its published gateway. Supply the credential that service accepts; its terms are yours to keep.
presets.keyHint: Free tier: paste public as the API key. Paid keys work too.
